message: The other day, while watching the weather report, I felt that familiar twinge of panic that usually hits when storm warnings roll in. But this time, instead of scrambling around like a headless chicken, I found myself smiling. I had my flashlight batteries stocked, extra water in the pantry, and enough snacks to feed a small army. For once, I felt like the grown-up in the room! Who knew being prepared could feel so... empowering? 😊
